title: Gham e Hussain Meray Dil Se Kum Na Ho
body:
Ya Murtaza Ali Mujhy Duniya Ka Gham Na Ho
<<MINI>>
Lakin Gham e Hussain Meray Dil Se Kum Na Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Khushiyoun Se Dor Hoker Jeeta Rahon Ga Moula
Is Gham Se Dor Hoker Jeena Sakon Ga Moula
Koi Khushi Naseeb Main Chahay Raqam Na Ho
<<MINI>>
Lakin Gham e Hussain Meray Dil Se Kum Na Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Wo Din Bhe Jald Aaye Aye Do Jahan Kay Sahib
Rota Howa Najaf Say Karb o Bala Ki Janib
Itna Chalo Kay Bs Mere Sanson Main Dum Na Ho
<<MINI>>
Lakin Gham e Hussain Meray Dil Se Kum Na Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Mushkil Kusha Tmhe Ko Main Manta Hoon Moula
Sb Pr Karam Keya Hai Yay Janta Hoon Moula
Beshak Mere Hayat Main Koi Karam Na Ho
<<MINI>>
Lakin Gham e Hussain Meray Dil Se Kum Na Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Shabeer Kay He Gham Say Milti Hai Dil Ko Rahat
Kab Mangta Hoon Moula Duniya Ki Badshahat
Beshak Meray Naseeb Main Jahohasham Na Ho
<<MINI>>
Lakin Gham e Hussain Meray Dil Se Kum Na Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Rotay Howay Sakina Kehnay Lagi Phuppi Say
Ro'on To Shimr Aker Maray Mujhy Tamachy
Kejay Dua Kay Ab Mere Yay Ankh Num Na Ho
<<MINI>>
Lakin Gham e Hussain Meray Dil Se Kum Na Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Chahay Jawan Lasha Baity Ka Main Uthao
Yaad e Hussain Lekar Mayyat Pe Uski Jao'n
Chalnay Ki Tab Khatam Ho Uthta Qadam Na Ho
<<MINI>>
Lakin Gham e Hussain Meray Dil Se Kum Na Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Shabeer Kay Leyay He Manga Hai Main Nay Ghazi
Ummul Banee Kay Lab Per Bs Ake Yay Dua The
Jab Tak Giyoun Mujhy Meray Ghazi Ka Ghum Na Ho
<<MINI>>
Lakin Gham e Hussain Meray Dil Se Kum Na Ho
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Rehan Azmi Yay Kehnay Lagy Raza Say
Ro Ro Kay Aje Main Ny Manga Hai Murtaza Say
Duniya Main Meray Naam Ka Chahay Bharam Na Ho
<<MINI>>
Lakin Gham e Hussain Meray Dil Se Kum Na Ho
